description_en: Queries the list of cloud recordings
description_zh: 调用该接口查询云端录像列表
name: QueryRecord

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to view information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html on IoT Platform to query this ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The stream type. Valid values:
0 (default): main stream.
1: sub stream
parameters.help_zh:
码流类型：
0（默认）：主码流。
1：辅码流
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围开始时间，格式为10位时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围结束时间，格式为10位时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The recording type. Valid values:

0: continuous recording.
1: intelligent alert event recording.
2 (default): active recording.

If this parameter is left empty, all recording types are returned
parameters.help_zh:
录像类型：

0：连续录像。
1：智能告警事件录像。
2（默认）：主动录像。

当该参数值置空时，返回全部录像类型
parameters.name: record_type

parameters.help_en: The page number to start displaying results from. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果第几页开始显示，默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether a thumbnail is required. Valid values:

true: Required.
false (default): Not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要缩略图：

true：需要。
false（默认）：不需要
parameters.name: need_snapshot

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview tab in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

BeginTime.description_en: The start time of the recording

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the recording

EventType.description_en:
The event type corresponding to the recording. This parameter is returned only when the recording type (RecordType) is intelligent alert event recording.

For example, 1 indicates a motion detection event
EventType.description_zh:
录像类型（RecordType）为智能告警事件录像时返回该参数，表示录像对应的事件类型。

例如：1表示移动侦测事件

FileSize.description_en: The recording file size, in bytes
FileSize.description_zh: 录像文件大小，单位为字节

RecordType.description_en:
The recording type. Valid values:

0: continuous recording.
1: intelligent alert event recording.
2: active recording
RecordType.description_zh:
录像类型：

0：连续录像。
1：智能告警事件录像。
2：主动录像

StreamType.description_en:
The stream type. Valid values:
0: main stream.
1: sub stream
StreamType.description_zh:
码流类型：
0：主码流。
1：辅码流

VideoFrameNumber.description_en: The number of video frames in the recording file

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
